references.text: Psalm 18:25 describes God's protection of the righteous, which resembles the image of the house built on a rock in Matthew 7:25 that stands firm despite the storms.
Isaiah 28:16 speaks of a foundation laid in Zion, a precious cornerstone representing security and stability, parallel to the house built on a rock in Matthew 7:25.
Hebrews 6:19 uses the image of an anchor that provides steadiness and safety, similar to how the house on the rock in Matthew 7:25 withstands the storms.
